pages.title: Models
pages.snippet:
Models

Four logical modes: gx-mini, gx-code, gx-auto and gx-max. gx-code is two independent Ornith Q5_K_M workers (01 on gx10-01, 02 on gx10-02). gx-auto routes light work to mini and coding to gx-code. gx-max is dual-worker solver + reviewer on those two workers.

pages.name: cluster
pages.title: Cluster
pages.snippet:
Cluster
Two separate computers. Two independent 128 GB unified-memory systems (about 121 GiB usable each). They do NOT share memory: there is no 256 GB pool. Each node runs its own models inside its own memory. Only gx-max spans both, as two tensor-parallel ranks that exchange activations over the ConnectX-7 RoCE rails.
